disrumpo.summary: Multiband distortion with 26 algorithms in 7 families, morphed per band on a 2D MorphPad or by the Sweep system.

gradus.summary: Step arpeggiator with 9 polymetric lanes, Euclidean rhythms, conditional triggers, a Markov Chain mode and MIDI echo delays.

innexus.summary: Analyses a sample or live sidechain into up to 96 harmonic partials and plays them back as a resynthesized voice.

iterum.summary: Ten delay engines in one plugin: tape, BBD, digital, ping-pong, reverse, multi-tap, granular, spectral, shimmer and freeze.

membrum.summary: 32-pad drum machine that synthesizes every hit by physical modelling: six exciters, six body models, no samples.

profundum.summary: Bass instrument with one voice over a centred sub anchor, morphed between two designed endpoints by Bass Morph.

ruinae.summary: Chaos and spectral hybrid synthesizer with 10 oscillator types, 13 filters, an 8-slot mod matrix and a polymetric arpeggiator.

seraphis.summary: Spectral organism synthesizer: 64-partial harmonic clouds through a modal body, with slow life modulators and five macro rings.

vorago.summary: Dark-ambient drone instrument: a partial cloud, noise organism, resonant peaks and a living colony, played through twelve macros.
